what: The element is revealed by blooming from cloud-like clumps — SVG fractal noise (scale .01 · 4 octaves · seed 7) used as alpha = Cut with 2·noise + offset and push the offset linearly from −2 → 2. To hide, run the same path backward in half the time. Once fully shown, remove the filter so the text is crisp

options.on: load (on attach · default) · view (once when it enters the screen) · state (shown when is-on is added to the element, hidden when removed — first title after loader · chosen item label)
options.dur: Bloom length (seconds), default 1.8 — original hero title and enter button use 2.5
options.delay: Wait before it blooms (sec), default 0 — original first title .3
options.freq: Noise scale, default .01 — the smaller, the larger the cloud clumps
options.fx:shown · fx:hidden: Event raised from the element when fully bloomed or fully hidden
